Population increased in Bath and North East Somerset

The estimated population of Bath and North East Somerset in 2024 was 200,028 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that Bath and North East Somerset's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Bath and North East Somerset increased by 4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Bath and North East Somerset was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Bath and North East Somerset

The average (median) age fell to 39.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Bath and North East Somerset has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Bath and North East Somerset is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Bath and North East Somerset's population of 200,028 usual residents was made up of:

  • 32,026 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16%)
  • 128,918 people aged 16 to 64 years, (64.4%)
  • 39,084 people aged 65 years and over, (19.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Bath and North East Somerset has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (16% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Bath and North East Somerset, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Bath and North East Somerset
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Bath and North East Somerset, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 209 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 1,542 births and 1,751 deaths in Bath and North East Somerset.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 36 (0%). There were 19,195 people entering the area and 19,231 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Bath and North East Somerset's population of 1,997 (1%) as a result of 4,264 people entering the area and 2,267 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Bath and North East Somerset was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Bath and North East Somerset in mid-2023 is 198,264.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 121 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,675 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 1,554 people.
